  extension/dist/extension.js extension/dist/conversation.js extension/dist/prompts.js extension/dist/modelApi.js extension/dist/searchWorker.js \
  extension/dist/pageWorker.js extension/dist/planMarkdown.js extension/dist/checkpointStore.js \
  extension/dist/review.js extension/dist/agentImport.js extension/dist/conversationGit.js extension/dist/bundledSkills.js \
  extension/dist/uiTextRuntime.js extension/dist/uiTextHooks.js extension/dist/uiTextSurfaces.js \
  extension/dist/uiText.js extension/dist/validation.js extension/dist/wire.js extension/dist/browserCheck.js extension/dist/browserRuntime.js \
  extension/dist/legalScan.js extension/dist/legal-data/NOTICE.md extension/dist/legal-data/provenance.json \
  extension/dist/sessionBoard.js extension/dist/reviewer.js \
  extension/dist/foreignHooks.js extension/dist/hookRuntime.js extension/dist/extensionHooks.js extension/dist/pluginHooks.js \
  extension/dist/codeIntel.js extension/dist/voice.js extension/dist/museCodeReviewer.js \
  extension/dist/report.js extension/dist/recorder.js \
  extension/dist/webFetch.js extension/dist/judge.js extension/docs/judge.md extension/dist/whatsNew.js extension/dist/whatsNew.json \
  extension/dist/webview/main.js extension/dist/webview/main.css \
  extension/dist/webview/whatsNew.js extension/dist/webview/whatsNew.css; do
